paragraphs.text: translated by
1. SWIFT, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people,
paragraphs.original: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām |

paragraphs.text: With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra. subdued at once a hundred armies.
paragraphs.original: संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः
paragraphs.translit: saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayatsākamindraḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle,
paragraphs.original: संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā |

paragraphs.text: Indra. the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.
paragraphs.original: तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा
paragraphs.translit: tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā

paragraphs.text: 3. He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band rings hosts together,
paragraphs.original: स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
paragraphs.translit: sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena |

paragraphs.text: Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.
paragraphs.original: संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता
paragraphs.translit: saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā

paragraphs.text: 4. Brhaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrām̐ apabādhamānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies.
paragraphs.original: प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम्
paragraphs.translit: prabhañjantsenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām

paragraphs.text: 5. Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing,
paragraphs.original: बलविज्ञाय स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
paragraphs.translit: balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvānvājī sahamāna ugraḥ |

paragraphs.text: The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित्
paragraphs.translit: abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit

paragraphs.text: 6. Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it.-
paragraphs.original: गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ।
paragraphs.translit: gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā |

paragraphs.text: Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.
paragraphs.original: इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम्
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam

paragraphs.text: 7. Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger,
paragraphs.original: अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
paragraphs.translit: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ |

paragraphs.text: Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless, may he protect our armies in our battles.
paragraphs.original: दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्योऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु
paragraphs.translit: duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḷayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu

paragraphs.text: 8. Indra guide these: Brhaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma;
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
paragraphs.translit: indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ |

paragraphs.text: And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.
paragraphs.original: देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम्
paragraphs.translit: devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram

paragraphs.text: 9. Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts, and Adityas.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram |

paragraphs.text: Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.
paragraphs.original: महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात्
paragraphs.translit: mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt

paragraphs.text: 10. Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits of my warring heroes.
paragraphs.original: उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि ।
paragraphs.translit: uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi |

paragraphs.text: Urge on the strong steeds' might, O Vrtra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.
paragraphs.original: उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः
paragraphs.translit: udvṛtrahanvājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army.
paragraphs.original: अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
paragraphs.translit: asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu |

paragraphs.text: May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset.
paragraphs.original: अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ उ देवा अवता हवेषु
paragraphs.translit: asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmām̐ u devā avatā haveṣu

paragraphs.text: 12. Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies and depart, O Apva.
paragraphs.original: अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
paragraphs.translit: amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi |

paragraphs.text: Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.
paragraphs.original: अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम्
paragraphs.translit: abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām

paragraphs.text: 13. Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defense.
paragraphs.original: प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु ।
paragraphs.translit: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu |

paragraphs.text: Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.
paragraphs.original: उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ
paragraphs.translit: ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha
